scripts.stop: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name = 'node.exe'\" | Where-Object CommandLine -like '*src*index.js*'; if ($p) { $p | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force }; Write-Host 'DA DUNG BOT' -ForegroundColor Yellow } else { Write-Host 'KHONG CO BOT CHAY' }"
scripts.status: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name = 'node.exe'\" | Where-Object CommandLine -like '*src*index.js*'; if ($p) { Write-Host ('RUNNING (PID: ' + $p.ProcessId + ')') -ForegroundColor Green } else { Write-Host 'STOPPED' -ForegroundColor Red }"
